description: The full record for one camp by slug: cost and its evidence, water, nearest toilet, recorded rules and stay limit, the season on a date (default today, UTC), the nearest fuel, water, grocery and dump station with straight-line miles, and what is unrecorded. Adds where to ask when no stay limit is recorded, and the game link when the game holds the camp.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD for the season reading; default today.

slug.description: The camp record id from find_camps.

name: camp_detail
title: One camp record in full
